class ExoplanetTransitCurve(Scene):

        star = Circle(radius=0.9, color=YELLOW, fill_color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.85).shift(LEFT * 3 + UP * 1.15)
        glow = Circle(radius=1.1, color=YELLOW, stroke_opacity=0.35).move_to(star)
        planet = Dot(star.get_left() + LEFT * 1.2, radius=0.18, color=BLUE_E)

from manim import *

class RCTimeConstant(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#F7F7F5"
        ink = "#202124"
        title = Text("One time constant reaches about 63%—not full charge", font_size=35, color=ink).to_edge(UP)
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[0, 5, 1], y_range=[0, 1.1, 0.2], x_length=8, y_length=4.4,
            tips=False, axis_config={"color": ink},
        ).shift(DOWN * 0.25)
        labels = axes.get_axis_labels(Text("time / τ", font_size=22, color=ink), Text("V / supply", font_size=22, color=ink))
        curve = axes.plot(lambda t: 1 - np.exp(-t), x_range=[0, 5], color=BLUE_D)
        asymptote = DashedLine(axes.c2p(0, 1), axes.c2p(5, 1), color=GRAY_D)
        tau_x = DashedLine(axes.c2p(1, 0), axes.c2p(1, 1 - np.exp(-1)), color=ORANGE)
        level = DashedLine(axes.c2p(0, 1 - np.exp(-1)), axes.c2p(1, 1 - np.exp(-1)), color=ORANGE)
        probe = Dot(axes.i2gp(0, curve), color=ORANGE)
        path_to_tau = axes.plot(lambda t: 1 - np.exp(-t), x_range=[0, 1], color=BLUE_D, stroke_opacity=0)
        marker = Text("τ → 0.63", font_size=25, color=ORANGE).next_to(axes.c2p(1, 0.63), UR)
        final = Text("Charging continues after τ and approaches the supply asymptotically.", font_size=23, color=ink).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(FadeIn(title, axes, labels, asymptote), Create(curve), FadeIn(probe))
        self.play(MoveAlongPath(probe, path_to_tau), run_time=3, rate_func=linear)
        self.play(Create(tau_x), Create(level), FadeIn(marker))
        self.play(Indicate(asymptote, color=GREEN_D), FadeIn(final))
        self.wait(3)

from manim import *

class QueueBottleneck(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("When arrivals outpace service, the queue grows", font_size=37).to_edge(UP)
        source = Text("arrivals", font_size=24, color=BLUE_B).shift(LEFT * 5 + UP * 1.5)
        server = VGroup(
            RoundedRectangle(width=2.1, height=1.25, corner_radius=0.15, color=ORANGE),
            Text("workstation", font_size=24),
        ).shift(RIGHT * 2)
        exit_label = Text("completed", font_size=23, color=GREEN).shift(RIGHT * 5 + UP * 1.5)
        queue_slots = VGroup(*[
            Square(side_length=0.62, color=GRAY_B).shift(LEFT * (2.9 - index * 0.72))
            for index in range(5)
        ]).shift(DOWN * 0.1)
        jobs = VGroup(*[
            Circle(radius=0.19, color=BLUE_B, fill_opacity=0.8).move_to(queue_slots[index])
            for index in range(2)
        ])
        rate_caption = Text("arrival rate > service rate", font_size=25, color=RED).to_edge(DOWN)
        calmer = Text("fewer arrivals → the queue can drain", font_size=25, color=GREEN).to_edge(DOWN)
        boundary = Text("Near capacity, variability can create long waits.", font_size=24, color=YELLOW).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(Write(title), FadeIn(source, server, exit_label), Create(queue_slots), FadeIn(jobs))
        new_jobs = VGroup(*[
            Circle(radius=0.19, color=BLUE_B, fill_opacity=0.8).move_to(LEFT * 5 + DOWN * (0.2 * index))
            for index in range(3)
        ])
        self.play(FadeIn(rate_caption), LaggedStart(*[
            new_jobs[index].animate.move_to(queue_slots[index + 2]) for index in range(3)
        ], lag_ratio=0.2), run_time=2.5)
        self.add(new_jobs)
        served = jobs[0]
        self.play(served.animate.move_to(server.get_center()), Indicate(server, color=ORANGE))
        self.play(served.animate.move_to(RIGHT * 5), FadeOut(served))
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(rate_caption, calmer))
        remaining = VGroup(jobs[1], *new_jobs)
        self.play(LaggedStart(*[
            job.animate.shift(RIGHT * 0.72) for job in remaining
        ], lag_ratio=0.15))
        self.play(LaggedStart(
            FadeOut(remaining[-1], shift=RIGHT * 3),
            FadeOut(remaining[-2], shift=RIGHT * 3),
            lag_ratio=0.4,
        ), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(calmer, boundary), Circumscribe(queue_slots, color=YELLOW))
        self.wait(2)

            Text("balance = 10", font_size=25, color=ink),

        t2 = VGroup(Text("T2", font_size=26, color=ORANGE), Text("read 10 → write 12", font_size=23, color=ink)).arrange(DOWN).shift(RIGHT * 3)
        read_arrows = VGroup(

        self.play(Transform(db[1], db12), FadeIn(final_bad))
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(final_bad, serialize))
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(serialize, boundary), Circumscribe(db, color=RED))

from manim import *

class DijkstraFrontier(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Dijkstra settles the smallest tentative distance", font_size=36).to_edge(UP)
        vertices = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E"]
        edges = [("A","B"), ("A","C"), ("B","D"), ("C","D"), ("C","E"), ("D","E")]
        layout = {
            "A": LEFT * 4,
            "B": LEFT * 1.8 + UP * 1.5,
            "C": LEFT * 1.8 + DOWN * 1.5,
            "D": RIGHT * 1.2 + UP * 0.8,
            "E": RIGHT * 4 + DOWN * 0.6,
        }
        graph = Graph(
            vertices, edges, layout=layout,
            vertex_config={"radius": 0.28, "color": GRAY_B, "fill_opacity": 0.35},
            edge_config={"color": GRAY_B},
            labels=False,
        )
        node_labels = VGroup(*[
            Text(vertex, font_size=22, color=WHITE).move_to(graph.vertices[vertex])
            for vertex in vertices
        ])
        weights = {
            ("A","B"): 2, ("A","C"): 5, ("B","D"): 2,
            ("C","D"): 1, ("C","E"): 5, ("D","E"): 2,
        }
        weight_labels = VGroup(*[
            Text(str(weight), font_size=19, color=YELLOW).move_to(
                (graph.vertices[left].get_center() + graph.vertices[right].get_center()) / 2
            )
            for (left, right), weight in weights.items()
        ])
        distance_text = Text("tentative: B=2, C=5", font_size=24).to_edge(DOWN)
        step2 = Text("settle B=2 → update D=4", font_size=24).to_edge(DOWN)
        step3 = Text("settle D=4 → update E=6", font_size=24).to_edge(DOWN)
        step4 = Text("C=5 is next; only then E=6", font_size=24).to_edge(DOWN)
        caveat = Text("Correctness requires nonnegative edge weights.", font_size=23, color=ORANGE).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(Write(title), Create(graph), FadeIn(node_labels, weight_labels))
        self.play(graph.vertices["A"].animate.set_fill(BLUE_B, opacity=0.9), FadeIn(distance_text))
        self.play(graph.vertices["B"].animate.set_fill(GREEN, opacity=0.9), ReplacementTransform(distance_text, step2))
        self.play(Indicate(graph.edges[("B","D")], color=GREEN))
        self.play(graph.vertices["D"].animate.set_fill(GREEN, opacity=0.9), ReplacementTransform(step2, step3))
        self.play(Indicate(graph.edges[("D","E")], color=GREEN))
        self.play(graph.vertices["C"].animate.set_fill(GREEN, opacity=0.9), ReplacementTransform(step3, step4))
        self.play(graph.vertices["E"].animate.set_fill(GREEN, opacity=0.9), ReplacementTransform(step4, caveat))
        self.wait(3)

    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Average transmission shrinks below one and grows above one", font_size=34).to_edge(UP)
        divider = DashedLine(UP * 2.4, DOWN * 2.3, color=GRAY_B)
        labels = VGroup(
            Text("effective R < 1", font_size=27, color=GREEN).shift(LEFT * 3.3 + UP * 2.0),
            Text("effective R > 1", font_size=27, color=RED).shift(RIGHT * 3.3 + UP * 2.0),
        )
        left_levels = [
            [LEFT * 3.9 + UP * 1.1, LEFT * 3.3 + UP * 1.1, LEFT * 2.7 + UP * 1.1],
            [LEFT * 3.7 + UP * 0.1, LEFT * 2.9 + UP * 0.1],
            [LEFT * 3.3 + DOWN * 0.9],
        ]
        right_levels = [
            [RIGHT * 3.9 + UP * 1.1, RIGHT * 3.3 + UP * 1.1, RIGHT * 2.7 + UP * 1.1],
            [RIGHT * 4.2 + UP * 0.1, RIGHT * 3.6 + UP * 0.1, RIGHT * 3.0 + UP * 0.1, RIGHT * 2.4 + UP * 0.1],
            [RIGHT * 5.0 + DOWN * 0.9, RIGHT * 4.4 + DOWN * 0.9, RIGHT * 3.8 + DOWN * 0.9, RIGHT * 3.2 + DOWN * 0.9, RIGHT * 2.6 + DOWN * 0.9, RIGHT * 2.0 + DOWN * 0.9],
        ]
        left_nodes = [VGroup(*[Dot(point, color=GREEN, radius=0.12) for point in level]) for level in left_levels]
        right_nodes = [VGroup(*[Dot(point, color=RED, radius=0.12) for point in level]) for level in right_levels]
        left_edges = VGroup(
            Line(left_levels[0][0], left_levels[1][0], color=GREEN, stroke_opacity=0.6),
            Line(left_levels[0][1], left_levels[1][1], color=GREEN, stroke_opacity=0.6),
            Line(left_levels[1][0], left_levels[2][0], color=GREEN, stroke_opacity=0.6),
        )
        right_edges = VGroup(*[Line(right_levels[0][parent], point, color=RED, stroke_opacity=0.6) for parent, point in zip([0, 0, 1, 2], right_levels[1])], *[Line(right_levels[1][parent], point, color=RED, stroke_opacity=0.6) for parent, point in zip([0, 0, 1, 2, 3, 3], right_levels[2])])
        shrink = Text("average chain contracts", font_size=23, color=GREEN).shift(LEFT * 3.3 + DOWN * 2.0)
        grow = Text("average chain expands", font_size=23, color=RED).shift(RIGHT * 3.3 + DOWN * 2.0)
        caveat = Text("R is an average—not a guarantee for any one case.", font_size=24).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(Write(title), Create(divider), FadeIn(labels, left_nodes[0], right_nodes[0]))
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(Create(VGroup(*left_edges[:2])), Create(VGroup(*right_edges[:4])), FadeIn(left_nodes[1], right_nodes[1]))
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(Create(VGroup(*left_edges[2:])), Create(VGroup(*right_edges[4:])), FadeIn(left_nodes[2], right_nodes[2]))
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(FadeIn(shrink, grow), Indicate(left_nodes[2], color=GREEN), Indicate(right_nodes[2], color=RED))
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(VGroup(shrink, grow), caveat))
        self.wait(2)
